classification: Reviewed conditional actual-radius/spike/bulk upper theorems and separately classified ACTUAL central-cell linear-field boundary; original convergence OPEN
conclusions: Actual cross radius enlarges the valid ellipsoid metric window and positive diagonal remainder for every original/weighted cell. Its original-radius compatibility bound is uniform even when the actual radius tends to zero.

The low-rank spike theorem projects only the Gaussian field and pays the rank/dispersion error. It retains each weighted Boolean state's spike mass inside both the original radius and the constrained Boolean remainder. Weighted conditioning, direction nets and finite mass bins justify the allocation maximum.

For actual zero-original-internal-energy cells with fixed S=O(n^(3/2)), delta->0, u_D->4/5 and weak cross squared law (delta_0+delta_(4/5))/2, the normalized base Gaussian width has limsup<=14/25, with no actual top-radius convergence premise.

For arbitrary bulk profiles the matched metric gives Gamma_r(m,u) from only first moment and a bulk edge r<1. No full spectral-law limit is required, and vanishing-relative-rank outliers are permitted.

At bulk edge<=9/10 and liminf original u_n=2c/S>=7/8, actual completeness supplies limsup m_n<=1/2. The squared normalized field upper is below 1/5, whereas the ORIGINAL source target has limiting square at least 2/pi^2>1/5. Consequently limsup [E max_cell X_z-2sqrt(2)Phi(A)]/n^(3/2)<=2/sqrt(5)-2sqrt(2)/pi<0 without an alpha=2/5 hypothesis.
The wider bulk<=9/10, liminf u_n>=4/5, limsup m_n<=2/5 region gives a separate alpha=2/5 diagnostic comparison, not an original-target statement for every smaller source norm.

The actual central-cell companion proves maximum actual linear-field widths/(2n^(3/2))->sqrt(kappa*w), for any feasible D, without trace-cap, dispersion or optimizer hypotheses. Thus the CENTERED all-cell linear-field upper cannot reach the original target at alpha<=1/2. A shifted-sign version necessarily needs w<=2alpha^2/kappa.
